rootCause:
Likely cause: The ECS backend service is experiencing repeated process termination with exit status 143, causing 53 critical runtime failures in the last 24 hours.
Confidence: medium
Supporting evidence:
• Highest-ranked finding: process or container failures in /ecs/posis-ar-backend-service — 53 occurrences (2.208/hour), severity critical.
• Also present: application-level errors in /aws/lambda/sellout-notify-file-lambda-job (596 occurrences, high); unclassified error lines in /aws/lambda/posis-email-service (72 occurrences, medium).
• Scope: 14 distinct findings across 6 log groups of 69 scanned in the last 24 hours.
• 2 log groups produced more matching events than the per-slice budget, so their occurrence counts are lower bounds.
executiveSummary:
• Degraded — 1 critical finding of 14 total across 6 log groups in the last 24 hours.
• Biggest issue: process or container failures in /ecs/posis-ar-backend-service — 53 occurrences at 2.208/hour (critical).
• Recurrence: 4 findings repeat on a regular interval — /aws-glue/jobs/error roughly every 52–109 minutes.
• Investigate first: /ecs/posis-ar-backend-service — highest-ranked finding by severity and rate.
• Investigate the critical runtime error in `/ecs/posis-ar-backend-service` showing npm exit status 143, then review the high-severity Lambda validation failures in `/aws/lambda/sellout-notify-file-lambda-job`.
• Coverage caveat: 2 log groups hit the event budget (counts are lower bounds).
